name: Newtonsoft.Json

scopeNotes.assembly_boundaries: One core production library only; no merged assemblies or external builds.

extra_exclusions.reason: vendored LINQBridge: file header attributes Atif Aziz and Joseph Albahari; New BSD License

scopeNotes.generated_file_policy: No additional generated C# exclusions identified; counter still excludes .g.cs and leading single-line auto-generated markers.

limitations: 548 if/elif/define/undef directives across 108 files; no HAVE_* or target-framework defines, so baseline does not represent any historical target.
40 CS0234 errors are imports of excluded LINQBridge; default implicit System.Linq keeps many extension calls available, unlike a real legacy build.
One CS0104 ambiguity comes from the baseline implicit System.IO using; two other errors select dynamic-code users while HAVE_REFLECTION_EMIT definitions remain inactive.
Async, dynamic, LINQ and framework-specific branches change the counted population; low binding-error count does not measure inactive-source omissions.
JsonWriter may dominate pair-weighted pooled TCC; consult raw counts, per-type quantiles and inspected roles rather than a single quality score.
